# Per-agent sanitized export
for d in /home/box/agent-data/agents/*/; do
  id=$(basename "$d")

  name=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('$d/profile.json')).get('name','unknown'))")
  safe=$(echo "$name" | tr ' /' '__' | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9._-')
  out="$EXPORT/agents/${safe}__${id}"
  mkdir -p "$out/memory" "$out/automations"
  cp "$d/profile.json" "$out/"
  [ -f "$d/settings.json" ] && cp "$d/settings.json" "$out/"
  # memory text only
  if [ -d "$d/memory" ]; then
    find "$d/memory" -type f \( -name '*.md' -o -name '*.txt' -o -name '*.json' \) -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
      rel=${f#"$d/memory/"}
      mkdir -p "$out/memory/$(dirname "$rel")"
      cp "$f" "$out/memory/$rel"
    done
  fi
  # automations: copy automation.json and any .md, scrub likely secrets later
  if [ -d "$d/automations" ]; then
    find "$d/automations" -type f \( -name 'automation.json' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.txt' \) -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
      rel=${f#"$d/automations/"}
      mkdir -p "$out/automations/$(dirname "$rel")"
      cp "$f" "$out/automations/$rel"
    done
  fi
  # omit: store.db*, conversation-blobs*, attachments, assets binaries, audit may have sensitive - include audit as optional scrubbed
  if [ -f "$d/audit.jsonl" ]; then
    # drop lines that look like secrets
    rg -v -i 'token|secret|password|api[_-]?key|bearer|sk_live|x-user-key' "$d/audit.jsonl" > "$out/audit.jsonl" || true
  fi
done

import json,urllib.request
syms=['NVDA','GE','META','AAPL','MSFT','COIN','HOOD','QQQ','XLV','NEM','TSLA','AMZN','CL=F','GC=F','SI=F','BTC-USD','ETH-USD']
# yahoo chart for 2d to get open/prevClose/regularMarket
out={}
for s in syms:
    url=f'https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/{s}?interval=1d&range=5d'
    req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=20) as r:
            j=json.load(r)
        meta=j['chart']['result'][0]['meta']
        ind=j['chart']['result'][0]['indicators']['quote'][0]
        ts=j['chart']['result'][0]['timestamp']
        # last completed + current
        opens=ind['open']; closes=ind['close']; highs=ind['high']
        # find last non-null close
        pairs=[(ts[i], opens[i], closes[i]) for i in range(len(ts)) if closes[i] is not None]
        last=pairs[-1]
        prev=pairs[-2] if len(pairs)>1 else last
        out[s]={
            'regularMarketPrice': meta.get('regularMarketPrice'),
            'previousClose': meta.get('chartPreviousClose') or meta.get('previousClose'),
            'open': last[1],
            'lastClose': last[2],
            'prevDayClose': prev[2],
            'timezone': meta.get('timezone'),
            'exchange': meta.get('exchangeName'),
        }
    except Exception as e:
        out[s]={'error':str(e)}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
